query:
WITH new_macro_user AS (
            INSERT INTO macro_user (id, username, email, stripe_customer_id)
            VALUES (gen_random_uuid(), $2, $2, $3)
            RETURNING id
        )
        INSERT INTO "User" ("id", "email", "macro_user_id")
        SELECT $1, $2, new_macro_user.id FROM new_macro_user
